content:
Create instructions for agents in an agent group to perform. Instructions include restarting or
changing local product settings.
Requires the Scan Manager [40] user role. See Roles.
AUTHORIZATIONS:
cloud
PATH PARAMETERS
integer <int32>
The ID or UUID of the agent group.
REQUEST BODY SCHEMA:
application/json
object
Specifies the criteria you wish to filter agents on. The criteria is used to
narrow down the list of agents to perform the specified action on.
Array of String for Agent UUIDs (OPTION 1) (string) or Integer for Agent IDs
(OPTION 2) (integer)
An array of agent IDs or agent UUIDs to add to the criteria filter.
Array of String for Agent UUIDs (OPTION 1) (string) or Integer for Agent IDs
(OPTION 2) (integer)
An array of agent IDs or agent UUIDs to exclude from the criteria filter.
Restart Directive (OPTION 1) (object) or Settings Directive (OPTION 2) (object)
Specifies the instructions you wish to send to the agents. The directive
object is different depending on whether you want to restart the agents or
change settings for the agents.
group_id
required
criteria
items
not_items
directive
